meta.name: csv-data-summarizer
meta.description: Analyzes CSV files, generates summary stats, and plots quick visualizations using Python and pandas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV 数据，生成统计摘要和图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常处理 CSV 文件并想知道数据整体情况。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV files to generate summary stats and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with CSV files and need quick insights.

howto.what: 收到CSV文件后,自动读取数据,根据内容判断类型并生成概览、统计摘要和缺失值分析,画出合适的图表,一次性给出分析结论,不反问用户。
howto.when: 当用户上传或引用CSV文件,要求总结、分析或可视化表格数据,或询问数据见解等时触发。

say.text: 这是我上传的销售数据CSV,请总结一下。
say.note: 会自动分析并生成统计摘要和图表。

say.text: 分析这个客户数据表格,展示趋势。
say.note: 会自动识别数据类型并画出趋势图。

say.text: 这份订单CSV里有什么发现?
say.note: 会一次性给出完整分析,不询问需求。

howto.what_en: After receiving a CSV file, it auto-reads data, identifies type, produces overview, stats, missing-value analysis and charts, then presents conclusions once without asking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user uploads or references a CSV file, asks to summarize, analyze, or visualize tabular data, or asks for data insights.

say_en.text: Here is my sales data CSV. Please summarize it.
say_en.note: Claude will auto-analyze and generate stats and charts.

say_en.text: Analyze this customer data table and show trends.
say_en.note: Claude will identify data types and draw charts.

say_en.text: What insights can you find in this orders CSV?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a full analysis without questions.
